messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Is it permissible to commission the cell's UR10e arm solely on the strength of the manufacturer's supplied declaration, prior to the entire robot cell having been declared compliant?

response.text: Può essere lecito mettere in servizio il braccio UR10e della cella sulla base della sola dichiarazione del costruttore, prima che l'intera cella robotizzata sia dichiarata conforme?
